resources.string: Following the system also follows its schedule, so the app turns dark when the phone does.
Bigger text, more space between letters and more air between lines — the adjustments that reading research actually backs. It adds to your system font size, it does not replace it.
Brings back the engine catalogue, the side-by-side comparison and the per-read latencies. Off by default: scanning a code does not require choosing a decoder.
Add a reference text to any scan, from the history or right after reading a code. A row of digits is exact and useless; "March invoice" is neither.
Looks at the scanned value and at your note, and finds "Factúra" when you type "factura".
Sticky headers saying "Today" and "Yesterday", which is what you actually remember about a scan you did not annotate.
Deleting one scan no longer asks — it offers to undo instead, and puts the row back in its place by date, with its note.
One scan per line, no header and no quoting. CSV and JSON are for tools; this is for pasting into an email.
In Settings → Accessibility. Bigger text, more space between letters and more air between lines.
No account, no tracking, no network. WhyScan does not request internet access at all, so what you scan cannot leave the device.
